module
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.BalancedTypedCompilerDefinitions
@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.BalancedTypedCompiler.Targets
open BalancedSyntax BalancedEvaluation

/-- Literal equality with the existing Formula.encode, for ALL typed source
certificates, expressions and integer signs. No genuineness, positivity or
lower-calibration premise restricts this exact connection to the accepted
unconditional all-code compiler. -/
def ExactTypedCodeCalibration : Prop :=
  ∀ (Γ : List Nat) (C : Certificate Γ) (E F : Syntax Γ) (desired : Int),
    BalancedRawCompiler.compileCode Γ (encodeCertificate Γ C)
        (encodeSyntax Γ E) (encodeSyntax Γ F) desired =
      (typedFormula Γ C E F desired).encode

/-- Structural support containment for ALL typed inputs, independently of
genuineness and valuation. This is the ORIGINAL pair support, before any
collection or filtering. Exact free-variable equality remains separate. -/
def OriginalSupportContainment : Prop :=
  ∀ (Γ : List Nat) (C : Certificate Γ) (E F : Syntax Γ) (desired : Int),
    ∀ i ∈ (typedFormula Γ C E F desired).variables,
      i ∈ rawVariables Γ C E ++ rawVariables Γ C F

/-- Actual-source sign truth under one genuine certificate and one raw
valuation. Positivity is required ONLY on the original pair support; every
outside coordinate remains unrestricted. The accepted guard supplier's
LowerCorrect premise must be discharged by structural induction, not passed
through as a premise here. All integer desired signs remain in the domain. -/
def ActualSignSemantics : Prop :=
  ∀ (Γ : List Nat) (C : Certificate Γ) (E F : Syntax Γ)
    (desired : Int) (ν : Nat → Nat),
    genuineCertificate Γ C →
    genuineExpression Γ E → genuineExpression Γ F →
    (∀ i ∈ rawVariables Γ C E ++ rawVariables Γ C F, 0 < ν i) →
    ((typedFormula Γ C E F desired).eval ν ↔
      Int.sign ((value Γ C E ν : Int) - (value Γ C F ν : Int)) = desired)

end LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.BalancedTypedCompiler.Targets

module
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.BalancedEvaluationDefinitions
public import Mathlib.Computability.Partrec
@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.BalancedEvaluation.Targets
open BalancedSyntax
/-- Exact actual closed-point evaluation/support for ORIGINAL finite balanced
certificates and ONE original finite raw table. No new independent basis vals. -/
def ActualSourceCalibration:Prop:=∀Γ:List Nat,∀C:Certificate Γ,∀E:Syntax Γ,∀table:Table,
  codeValue Γ (encodeCertificate Γ C) (encodeSyntax Γ E) table=
    value Γ C E (BaseTermPrograms.valuation table)∧
  codeVariables Γ (encodeCertificate Γ C) (encodeSyntax Γ E)=rawVariables Γ C E
/-- Genuine uniformly computable value AND raw-support extraction on ALL
shape/certificate/expression/table codes, not a supplied evaluator field. -/
def AllCodeComputation:Prop:=Computable (fun p:Input=>joint p)
def FiniteCallEquation:Prop:=
  (∀p q,q∈children p→q.1.length<p.1.length)∧∀p,joint p=assemble p ((children p).map joint)
def NumericalInterfaces:Prop:=Computable children∧Computable₂ assemble
end LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.BalancedEvaluation.Targets

module
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.BalancedBoxEvaluationDefinitions
public import Mathlib.Computability.Partrec
@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.BalancedBoxEvaluation.Targets
open BalancedSyntax BalancedEvaluation BalancedSmallBox

/-- The EXACT existing joint algorithm is uniformly computable on ALL raw
shape, certificate, expression and finite-table inputs. No validity oracle,
new evaluator, source-only restriction or bounded-code restriction. -/
def AllCodeComputation : Prop := Computable (fun p : Input => joint p)

/-- Literal typed calibration of the existing code functions, at every
finite raw table, including exact ordered support with its repetitions.
There are no genuine-certificate or positivity premises. -/
def ActualSourceCalibration : Prop := ∀ Γ : List Nat, ∀ C : Certificate Γ,
  ∀ E : Syntax Γ, ∀ table : Table,
  codeValue Γ (encodeCertificate Γ C) (encodeSyntax Γ E) table =
    value Γ C E (BaseTermPrograms.valuation table) ∧
  codeVariables Γ (encodeCertificate Γ C) (encodeSyntax Γ E) = rawVariables Γ C E

/-- Concrete table conversion is uniformly computable and pays its exact
lookup equality explicitly. Every accepted finite word evaluates both actual
sources using the existing joint program. An ambient-positive original
small-branch point has its canonical word with the same program results,
ALL original complete inputs and original small-branch truth. -/
def ExactBoxEvaluation : Prop :=
  Computable₂ finiteTable ∧
  (∀ support word : List Nat, word.length = support.length →
    (finiteTable support word).length = tableSize support ∧
    ∀ i : Nat, BaseTermPrograms.valuation (finiteTable support word) i =
      singleCoreBoxLookup support word i) ∧
  (∀ (k : Nat) (Γ : List Nat) (C : Certificate (k :: Γ))
    (E F : Upper k) (word : List Nat), word ∈ boxWords k Γ C E F →
    joint (k :: Γ, encodeCertificate (k :: Γ) C, encodeSyntax (k :: Γ) E,
        boxTable k Γ C E F word) =
      (value (k :: Γ) C E (boxValuation k Γ C E F word), rawVariables (k :: Γ) C E) ∧
    joint (k :: Γ, encodeCertificate (k :: Γ) C, encodeSyntax (k :: Γ) F,
        boxTable k Γ C E F word) =
      (value (k :: Γ) C F (boxValuation k Γ C E F word), rawVariables (k :: Γ) C F) ∧
    completeInputs k Γ C E F (BaseTermPrograms.valuation (boxTable k Γ C E F word)) =
      completeInputs k Γ C E F (boxValuation k Γ C E F word)) ∧
  (∀ (k : Nat) (Γ : List Nat) (C : Certificate (k :: Γ))
    (E F : Upper k) (ν : Nat → Nat), genuineCertificate (k :: Γ) C →
    positiveOn (sourceAmbient k Γ C E F) ν → smallBranch k Γ C E F ν →
    ∃ word : List Nat,
      word = (sourceSupport k Γ C E F).map ν ∧
      word ∈ boxWords k Γ C E F ∧
      (∀ i ∈ sourceAmbient k Γ C E F,
        BaseTermPrograms.valuation (boxTable k Γ C E F word) i = ν i) ∧
      (∀ i, i ∉ sourceAmbient k Γ C E F →
        BaseTermPrograms.valuation (boxTable k Γ C E F word) i = 1) ∧
      joint (k :: Γ, encodeCertificate (k :: Γ) C, encodeSyntax (k :: Γ) E,
          boxTable k Γ C E F word) = (value (k :: Γ) C E ν, rawVariables (k :: Γ) C E) ∧
      joint (k :: Γ, encodeCertificate (k :: Γ) C, encodeSyntax (k :: Γ) F,
          boxTable k Γ C E F word) = (value (k :: Γ) C F ν, rawVariables (k :: Γ) C F) ∧
      completeInputs k Γ C E F (BaseTermPrograms.valuation (boxTable k Γ C E F word)) =
        completeInputs k Γ C E F ν ∧
      smallBranch k Γ C E F (BaseTermPrograms.valuation (boxTable k Γ C E F word)))

end LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.BalancedBoxEvaluation.Targets

module
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.BalancedRawCompilerDefinitions
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.FiniteGraphDefinitions
@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.BalancedRawCompiler.Targets

/-- Exact structural recursion, not an equation supplied as a premise.
The leaf is a literal actual BASE comparison, including reversed strict
order and falsity for all other desired signs. The child shape/certificate
laws connect the recursion on Γ to the ACTUAL numeric query tuples. -/
def ExactFiniteCallEquation : Prop :=
  (∀ (C E F : Nat) (desired : Int),
    compileCode [] C E F desired = baseCode E F desired) ∧
  (∀ (C : Nat) (E F : CommonLayerSyntax.BaseTerm) (desired : Int),
    compileCode [] C E.encode F.encode desired = (baseFormula E F desired).encode ∧
    ∀ ν : Nat → Nat,
      ((baseFormula E F desired).eval ν ↔
        Int.sign ((E.value ν : Int) - (F.value ν : Int)) = desired)) ∧
  (∀ (k : Nat) (Γ : List Nat) (C E F : Nat) (desired : Int),
    (children (k :: Γ,C,E,F,desired)).length =
      (BalancedSourceAdapter.formulaCode k E F desired).length ∧
    ∀ a ∈ children (k :: Γ,C,E,F,desired),
      a.1 = Γ ∧ a.2.1 = BalancedSourceAdapter.lowerCertificate C) ∧
  (∀ (a b : Input), b ∈ children a → measure b < measure a) ∧
  (∀ a : Input, recursiveCode a = assemble a ((children a).map recursiveCode))

/-- Concrete algorithms for every actual interface, uniformly on ALL raw
shapes, certificates, source codes, desired integers and result lists.
No source validity, lower comparator, computability witness or correctness
premise is supplied by the caller. -/
def NumericalInterfaces : Prop :=
  Computable (fun p : Nat × Nat × Int => baseCode p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) ∧
  Computable children ∧
  Computable₂ assemble ∧
  Computable measure

/-- The unchanged finite-frontier graph computes the specific structural
constructor, and that constructor is uniformly computable on every raw
input. Typed positive-level formula calibration, semantic/support induction
and quantified BASE decision are separate, still-pending obligations. -/
def AllCodeComputation : Prop :=
  (∀ a : Input,
    FiniteGraph.graph children assemble measure a (measure a + 1) = [(a,recursiveCode a)]) ∧
  Computable recursiveCode

end LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.BalancedRawCompiler.Targets

module
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.BalancedExactVariablesDefinitions
public import Mathlib.Computability.Partrec
@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.BalancedExactVariables.Targets
open BalancedSyntax BalancedEvaluation

/-- Unchanged truth at EVERY raw valuation and exact membership equality of
syntactic variable sets for ALL typed inputs. No genuineness or positivity
premise is allowed. This includes cancellation, empty support and every
integer desired sign. Equality is of membership, not list order/multiplicity. -/
def TruthAndExactVariables : Prop :=
  ∀ (Γ : List Nat) (C : Certificate Γ) (E F : Syntax Γ) (desired : Int),
    (∀ ν : Nat → Nat,
      (sourceFormula Γ C E F desired).eval ν ↔
        (BalancedTypedCompiler.typedFormula Γ C E F desired).eval ν) ∧
    (∀ i : Nat,
      i ∈ (sourceFormula Γ C E F desired).variables ↔
        i ∈ rawVariables Γ C E ++ rawVariables Γ C F)

/-- The padded ordinary BASE formula has the actual source sign under a
genuine certificate and genuine expressions. Positivity is required ONLY on
the ORIGINAL pair support; all other raw coordinates remain unrestricted. -/
def ActualSignSemantics : Prop :=
  ∀ (Γ : List Nat) (C : Certificate Γ) (E F : Syntax Γ)
    (desired : Int) (ν : Nat → Nat),
    genuineCertificate Γ C →
    genuineExpression Γ E → genuineExpression Γ F →
    (∀ i ∈ rawVariables Γ C E ++ rawVariables Γ C F, 0 < ν i) →
    ((sourceFormula Γ C E F desired).eval ν ↔
      Int.sign ((value Γ C E ν : Int) - (value Γ C F ν : Int)) = desired)

/-- Literal code equality with the EXISTING Formula.encode for ALL typed
inputs at EVERY shape, including []. No validity, positivity, lower-comparator
or calibration premise is supplied by the caller. -/
def ExactTypedCodeCalibration : Prop :=
  ∀ (Γ : List Nat) (C : Certificate Γ) (E F : Syntax Γ) (desired : Int),
    formulaCode Γ (encodeCertificate Γ C)
        (encodeSyntax Γ E) (encodeSyntax Γ F) desired =
      (sourceFormula Γ C E F desired).encode

/-- Uniform total computability of this SPECIFIC unchanged-compiler wrapper
on EVERY raw shape, certificate code, expression code and integer desired sign.
No source-validity premise and no claim of malformed-code semantic validity. -/
def AllCodeComputation : Prop := Computable outputCode

end LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.LayeredComparison.BalancedExactVariables.Targets
